title: Mitigation-Survey Addition to a HomeFlood Re-Rate Credit
content:
**Purpose.** HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies adds to a re-rate credit when the certificate under review documents engineered flood openings, and adds more when the survey is recent. A survey is recent when it was made fewer than 3 whole calendar months before Tidemark received the certificate.

| Certificate under review | Survey age at receipt | Mitigation-survey addition |
|---|---|---|
| certifies engineered flood openings | fewer than 3 whole months | 10 percent of the pro rata amount |
| certifies engineered flood openings | 3 or more whole months | 5 percent of the pro rata amount |
| certifies no engineered flood openings | any | none |

The addition is a percent of the unrounded pro rata amount and is added to that amount; the re-rate credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

**Records read.** The certificate under review is the most recently received Elevation Certificate entry on the policy; where several share the latest receipt date, the one recorded first counts. It is read for its flood openings, its survey date and the date Tidemark received it. A count of whole calendar months runs from the earlier date to the later one; the last month is not counted when the later date's day of the month falls before the earlier date's day of the month.

## Boundary cases

| Survey date | Received | Whole months | Addition, openings certified |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 9 June | 2 | 10 percent |
| 10 March | 10 June | 3 | 5 percent |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a pro rata amount of 150.00 on a certificate surveyed six weeks before receipt that certifies engineered openings carries a 10 percent addition. The re-rate credit is 150.00 plus 15.00, that is 165.00.
